meta.name: poc
meta.description: Run a bounded customer proof of concept to test a consequential uncertainty. Use for a spike or pilot with a question and decision deadline, not a full rollout.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把高风险的设想变成有期限的小实验,验证后再决定是否推进
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果有个高风险假设要在期限内验证再决定是否投入
copy.tagline_en: Turn a risky assumption into a time-boxed experiment and decide with evidence
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a high-stakes assumption must be tested before you commit.

howto.what: 它让 Claude 按一套有边界的流程跑客户概念验证:先读任务上下文契约和方法文档,基于已获许可的上下文工作,保留未知项,并区分实现、验证、部署与验收。
howto.when: 当你需要做一次有边界的试验(spike 或试点),带着一个待验证的问题和决策截止日期时触发;不用于完整推广上线。

say.text: 帮我跑一次概念验证,要验证的问题和决策截止日期我这就给你。
say.note: 它会先读任务上下文契约再动手。

say.text: 基于这份客户上下文做一次 spike,标明哪些已验证、哪些仍是未知。
say.note: 未知项会被保留,不会被当成已解决。

say.text: 这次由 @fde 调用,请沿用它的上下文包和范围,不要重新开始。
say.note: 跳过已答过的发现与提问。

howto.what_en: It makes Claude run a bounded customer PoC: it first reads the task context contract and the method, works from the permitted context, preserves unknowns, and separates implementation, verification, deployment and acceptance.
howto.when_en: Use it when you run a bounded spike or pilot that has a question and a decision deadline; not for a full rollout.

say_en.text: Run a proof of concept — I'll give you the question and the decision deadline.
say_en.note: It reads the task context contract first.

say_en.text: Do a spike on this customer context and flag what's verified vs unknown.
This is called by @fde — reuse its packet and scope, don't restart setup.
